scenes.text: Psst! Hey you! Free GTA Six, for PC! Tonight only!
Rocco! Rocco! FREE GTA Six! For PC!
Just click the link! Trust me! I'm a professional!
GTA Six is only on PlayStation and Xbox. There is no PC version.
A very bad week. It steals your passwords.
My passwords?! I only have, like, three!
Your move: buy it only in the official console store.
Wait... what about the FREE one?
Wait, what?! No, no, no, no!
